title: NEWTRAL MagicH-GPRO Ergonomic Chair Review: Ultimate Support for WFH & Gaming
metaDescription: NEWTRAL MagicH-GPRO ergonomic chair review: Patented auto-following lumbar support, 5D headrest, 4D armrests, foldable footrest, and 136° recline.
author: ByteBuy Team

sections.content: Finding the right ergonomic chair for long hours at the desk can be a challenge, especially when back support needs to adapt as you move. The NEWTRAL MagicH-GPRO sets itself apart with a patented auto-following backrest and lumbar support mechanism designed to maintain proper spine alignment continuously. Paired with a foldable footrest, 5D adjustable headrest, and 4D armrests, this chair promises an all-in-one seating solution for work, gaming, and relaxation.

items.label: Lumbar Support
items.value: Patented Auto-Following Mechanism with 3 Lockable Positions

items.label: Seat Adjustment
items.value: Seat height (44–52.5 cm) & Seat depth (37.5–47.5 cm)

items.label: Certifications
items.value: Class 4 SGS Gas Lift, BIFMA & EN1335

pros: Patented auto-following backrest dynamic support significantly reduces lower back strain
Highly customizable posture options: 5D headrest, 4D armrests, and seat depth adjustment
Foldable footrest paired with a 136° recline creates an ideal setup for quick breaks or WFH relaxation
Breathable mesh backrest combined with a stress-divided high-density foam seat cushion
Solid build quality featuring a Class-4 gas lift and BIFMA/EN1335 safety standards
Accommodates a broad height range (5'3" to 6'3" / 160–190 cm)
cons: Heavy unit weight (~24.5 kg chair / 37 kg package) requires extra effort during assembly and unboxing
Auto-following lumbar support mechanism can feel slightly rigid for users who prefer plush, soft padding
Base structure occupies a noticeable amount of floor space

items.question: How does the Auto-Following Lumbar Support work?
items.answer: The patented lumbar mechanism physically pivots and tracks your movement as you lean forward, sit straight, or tilt back. This ensures constant support for the natural S-curve of your lower spine without needing manual adjustment every time you shift positions.

items.question: Is the NEWTRAL MagicH-GPRO suitable for tall or short users?
items.answer: Yes, the chair is designed for users between 5'3" and 6'3" (160 cm to 190 cm). The combination of adjustable seat depth (37.5 cm to 47.5 cm), seat height (44 cm to 52.5 cm), and backrest height adjustments allows for precise tailoring.

items.question: Can the footrest be stored away when not in use?
items.answer: Yes, the footrest folds and retracts neatly under the seat cushion, completely out of the way when you are sitting upright or working.

items.question: What is the difference between the GPRO and standard MagicH models?
items.answer: The MagicH-GPRO comes fully equipped with the foldable footrest, enhanced 5D auto-following headrest, extended 4D armrests, and compatibility with optional detachable laptop table attachments (sold separately).

sections.content: The NEWTRAL MagicH-GPRO Ergonomic Chair is a feature-packed seating solution designed to address common posture issues associated with long hours at a desk. Its dynamic lumbar tracking, high adjustability range, and integrated footrest make it a strong contender for remote workers, gamers, and anyone seeking comprehensive ergonomic support without moving into ultra-high-end price categories.
